DCSG.name: Decimal String
DCSG.definition: Wait for a string of digit characters with a decimal point, the length range could be specified.

DGSG.name: Digit String
DGSG.definition: Wait for a string of digit characters.

GAKY.name: Get Any Key
GAKY.definition: Wait for a key pressed on the Terminal, to be able to read the message displayed on the Terminal.

GCNF.name: Get Confirmation
GCNF.definition: Wait for a confirmation Yes (Y) or No (N) on the Sale System. Wait for a confirmation (Valid or Cancel button) on the POI Terminal. The result of the command is a Boolean: True or False.

GFKY.name: Get Function Key
GFKY.definition: Wait for a function key pressed on the Terminal: From POI, Valid, Clear, Correct, Generic Function key number. From Sale, Generic Function key.

GMNE.name: Get Menu Entry
GMNE.definition: To choose an entry among a list of entries (all of them are not necessary selectable). The OutputFormat has to be MenuEntry.

PSWD.name: Password
PSWD.definition: Request to enter a password with masked characters while typing the password.

SITE.name: Site Manager
SITE.definition: Wait for a confirmation Yes (Y) or No (N) of the Site Manager on the Sale System.

TXSG.name: Text String
TXSG.definition: Wait for a string of alphanumeric characters.
